article_title: Airbnb hosts can no longer make guests strip beds and wash dishes under new rules

tasks.prompt: What is the main change described in the article?
options: Airbnb is limiting the cleaning tasks and other requests hosts can require from guests.
Airbnb is ending all cleaning fees for every reservation.
Guests must now sign private contracts with every host.
Hosts may now fine guests for breaking any house rule.
tasks.correct_answer: Airbnb is limiting the cleaning tasks and other requests hosts can require from guests.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת בכללים חדשים שמגבילים מטלות ניקיון ובקשות אחרות שמארחים יכולים להטיל על אורחים.

tasks.prompt: Which task should guests who pay a cleaning fee no longer be required to do?
options: Lock the front door when leaving.
Strip the beds and wash the dishes.
Respect local limits on shower time.
Tell the host about damage.
tasks.correct_answer: Strip the beds and wash the dishes.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: Airbnb קבעה שאורחים המשלמים דמי ניקיון לא אמורים לבצע עבודות שנחשבות לעבודת המנקה, ובהן הפשטת המיטות ושטיפת הכלים.

tasks.prompt: What does “onerous” mean when Airbnb says some rules felt confusing and onerous?
options: Popular and entertaining
Easy to remember
Burdensome or demanding
Required by national law
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בהקשר זה onerous פירושו מכביד או דורש מאמץ רב, ולכן Airbnb ביקשה לפשט את הכללים.

tasks.prompt: When do the revised rules apply?
options: Only to stays lasting more than a month
To every reservation made before November
Only after a host receives a complaint
To reservations booked on or after 20 November
tasks.correct_answer: To reservations booked on or after 20 November
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציינת במפורש שהכללים חלים על הזמנות שנעשו ב־20 בנובמבר או לאחריו.

tasks.prompt: Why will Airbnb display house rules more prominently and repeat them in reservation reminders?
options: To reduce surprises and make expectations clearer before and during a stay.
To encourage guests to negotiate cleaning fees after checkout.
To let hosts add unlimited rules without review.
To replace communication between guests and hosts.
tasks.correct_answer: To reduce surprises and make expectations clearer before and during a stay.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הצגה בולטת ותזכורות עוזרות לאורחים להבין מראש מה מצופה מהם ומצמצמות הפתעות ומחלוקות.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does it mean if a request is “flagged”?
options: It is automatically added to every listing.
It is translated into another language.
It is marked for review because it may not follow the rules.
It is approved by a homeowners association.
tasks.correct_answer: It is marked for review because it may not follow the rules.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: flagged כאן פירושו סומן לבדיקה משום שהבקשה עשויה שלא לעמוד בכללים; למארח יש אפשרות לערער.

tasks.prompt: Give two examples of requests that may still be considered reasonable under Airbnb's revised rules.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שתי דוגמאות הנתמכות בכתבה ולהסביר בקצרה מדוע הן סבירות.
expected_points: A host may ask guests to lock doors or follow ordinary safety and care instructions.
A host may limit shower time when local drought restrictions require water conservation.
A request may be allowed when it is required by law or a homeowners association.

tasks.prompt: Summarise why Airbnb changed its house-rule system and what the new system does.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את תלונות האורחים, את הבלבול סביב כללים מכבידים, ואת ההגבלות וההבהרות החדשות.
expected_points: Guests had complained about being asked to do extensive chores despite paying cleaning fees.
Airbnb said the previous system could be confusing, burdensome and hard to manage.
Hosts may use seven standard rules and other reasonable requests, but not cleaner-type tasks for fee-paying guests.
Rules will be shown more clearly and repeated in reservation reminders.

tasks.prompt: Why might strict checkout chores cause more frustration when a listing also charges a cleaning fee?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את תחושת חוסר ההוגנות באמצעות הקשר בין תשלום עבור ניקיון לבין דרישה לבצע עבודת ניקיון.
expected_points: The fee suggests that professional or host-provided cleaning is included in the price.
Requiring substantial chores can make guests feel they are paying twice: with money and labour.
The article notes long-running guest complaints about this combination.
A clear distinction between basic respect and cleaner-type work can reduce conflict.

tasks.prompt: Write a short, polite checkout message that follows the revised rules and uses the words “reasonable”, “reminder” and “cleaning fee”.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להשתמש נכון בשלוש המילים, לנסח בקשה מנומסת וסבירה, ולא לדרוש מאורח המשלם דמי ניקיון לבצע עבודת מנקה.
expected_points: Use all three required terms accurately.
Include a reasonable request such as locking the door or reporting damage.
Do not require stripping beds, washing dishes or taking rubbish offsite.
Keep the message clear and polite.
